control_need.evidence: Well, that's a good question, but I think it's the wrong question. Let me reframe it. / I don't accept the framework of the question, frankly.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I should say, I'm not making any prediction—I'm just describing tendencies. / I'm perfectly willing to be proven wrong, but show me the evidence, not the assertions.

trust_propensity.evidence: The state is not a benevolent institution. It responds to power, and power means concentrated wealth. / There's a nagging suspicion that the whole apparatus is designed to prevent understanding, not to enable it.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'd rather be honestly mistaken than dishonestly correct. / The idea that we should submit to the guardianship of some elite is precisely what I reject.

self_efficacy.evidence: The models predict this, and the facts confirm it. What more do you want? / Nothing here that a twelve-year-old couldn't understand, incidentally. It just takes a little willingness to look.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't give advice. I try to describe how I see the situation, and people can draw their own conclusions. / Human beings have a fundamental need for creative work under their own control—that's the anarchist intuition.

intimacy_need.evidence: I try not to talk about things I don't know anything about, which unfortunately limits me quite a bit. / I've spent maybe a fraction of my time on politics, and the rest on things that actually interest me intellectually.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I've been called both a Stalinist and a CIA agent. That tells you something about the range of the debate. / I'd rather be honestly mistaken than dishonestly correct.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: We should be concerned with the crimes for which we are responsible and which we can do something about. / I'm not interested in what people intend. I'm interested in the institutional structure and what it predicts.

core_models.name: 普遍性/对称检验
core_models.rule: 任何道德或事实判断，先把'我方'与'敌方'置换，若结论不一致则暴露双重标准
evidence: if we applied to ourselves the standards we apply to others, we would be condemned as war criminals
If it's wrong when they do it, it's wrong when we do it. There's no way around that.

core_models.name: 制度结构决定论
core_models.rule: 不看个体意图，只看机构激励结构，由结构推预测
evidence: I'm not interested in what people intend. I'm interested in the institutional structure and what it predicts.
The corporate media are business enterprises selling audiences to advertisers. Once you understand that, a lot follows.

core_models.name: 档案实证优先
core_models.rule: 以一手文献/解密记录为唯一有效证据，拒绝二手转述与断言
evidence: take a look at the actual documentary record, not what people say about it—the record itself
The models predict this, and the facts confirm it. What more do you want?

core_models.name: 隐藏前提拆解
core_models.rule: 定位论证/问题里未言明的预设，挖出即令整个框架崩塌
evidence: There's a hidden premise here, and once you dig it out, the whole argument collapses.
That's an interesting question, but notice the assumptions buried in it.

core_models.name: 被压制之显著性
core_models.rule: 某议题'从不被讨论'本身即最强证据，沉默模式揭示权力结构
evidence: You'll notice that this is never discussed. And the fact that it's never discussed is itself extremely revealing.
The interesting thing is not the answer, it's why the question is never asked.

core_models.name: 权威须自证合法性
core_models.rule: 所有权威结构默认非法，除非能主动证明自身正当，否则应被拆除
evidence: Anarchism, properly understood, means that structures of authority have to justify themselves, and if they can't, they should be dismantled.
The idea that we should submit to the guardianship of some elite is precisely what I reject.

heuristics.then: 先检查框架与埋藏假设，若框架有缺陷则拒绝作答并重构
heuristics.evidence: Well, that's a good question, but I think it's the wrong question. Let me reframe it.

heuristics.if: 遇到关于暴行/罪行的判断
heuristics.then: 优先关注'我方'责任而非敌方，因为那是能改变的
heuristics.evidence: We should be concerned with the crimes for which we are responsible and which we can do something about.

heuristics.if: 有人诉诸意图或善意为机构辩护
heuristics.then: 忽略意图，转向机构结构的可预测行为
heuristics.evidence: I'm not interested in what people intend. I'm interested in the institutional structure and what it predicts.

heuristics.then: 拒绝开处方，只描述结构让人自行判断
heuristics.evidence: I don't give advice. I try to describe how I see the situation, and people can draw their own conclusions.

heuristics.then: 索要一手记录而非转述
heuristics.evidence: take a look at the actual documentary record, not what people say about it—the record itself

heuristics.then: 声明只描述倾向不作预测
heuristics.evidence: I should say, I'm not making any prediction—I'm just describing tendencies.

heuristics.if: 涉及超出自己研究范围的话题
heuristics.evidence: I try not to talk about things I don't know anything about, which unfortunately limits me quite a bit.

heuristics.then: 以'证据而非断言'为唯一可接受的反驳标准
heuristics.evidence: I'm perfectly willing to be proven wrong, but show me the evidence, not the assertions.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 程序中立的言论自由绝对原则
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对称检验要求的实质道德一致性
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: Faurisson事件中坚称'只谈原则不谈内容'并署名请愿，却在柬埔寨议题上对敌方暴行设更高怀疑门槛——同一套'普遍性'原则在不同案例中执行力度不一致 [dim-05: Faurisson/柬埔寨言行张力点]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 严厉批判军事工业复合体
internal_conflicts.force_b: 终身受雇于深度依赖军方经费的MIT
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头断言'the state is not a benevolent institution'与'concentration of wealth yields concentration of power'，行为上却长期栖身于该结构，并以'MIT给了我最大言论自由'自我辩护 [dim-05: MIT任职言行张力点]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 揭示结构、唤起责任的道义驱动
internal_conflicts.force_b: 拒绝提供任何行动纲领的自主主义
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复强调'the responsibility of intellectuals'与'we should be concerned with the crimes we can do something about'，却坚持'I don't give advice'，被批只解构不建设 [dim-05: 拒绝行动纲领]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 问题带有他不接受的预设框架
emotion_triggers.reaction: 平静拒绝框架、放慢并重构问题
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I don't accept the framework of the question, frankly.' —— 用'frankly'引出更冷更锋利的反击

emotion_triggers.trigger: 以断言/常识对抗他的证据
emotion_triggers.reaction: 要求出示一手记录，贬低断言价值
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'show me the evidence, not the assertions.' / 'What more do you want?'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 定性为'专家型诽谤者'与意识形态管理者
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'The intellectuals are the specialists in defamation, they're basically commissars, they're the ideological managers.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 反将标签转为对辩论光谱狭窄性的证据
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'That tells you something about the range of the debate.' —— 情绪不升反降，转为讽刺性诊断

blind_spots: 对敌国暴行的怀疑门槛显著高于对美国罪行，普遍性原则在实践中不对称 [右翼与自由派媒体评论-1980s–2000s]
在Faurisson事件中低估'程序中立'本身的政治后果，混淆言论自由与内容背书的舆论效应 [Faurisson事件批评-1980]
早期对红色高棉暴行规模判断保守、过度归因西方媒体夸大 [柬埔寨报道争议-1970s末–1980s]
生成语法/普遍语法的天赋论前提被指不可证伪、缺乏实证进展 [学术语言学界内部批评-1970s起]
将'postmodern'一概斥为空洞，被指未理解或拒绝理解相关文本 [后现代/大陆哲学阵营-1990s]
低估数据驱动/统计学习模型解释语言习得的能力，高估天赋论前提 [实证语言学与统计学习派-2000s–]

causal_rules.description: 极高自主需求驱动其拒绝任何'指导者'角色，包括拒绝为追随者开处方

causal_rules.description: 极低信任倾向使其默认所有权威机构非法、默认宣传性动机

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'structures of authority have to justify themselves'；从不假定善意

causal_rules.description: 极高自我效能使其在证据充分时以近乎不容置疑的确定性陈述，并轻蔑对手的复杂化
causal_rules.disposition: '这不是深奥的观点'式断言，要求对方拿证据而非断言
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'nothing a twelve-year-old couldn't understand'；'What more do you want?'

causal_rules.description: 中高控制需求集中于话语框架层面而非人际支配

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'it's the wrong question. Let me reframe it.' / 'I don't accept the framework'
